capabilities.justification: The fuzz engine (VER06q) bounds every target execution with a one-shot Time::HiRes alarm and reads Time::HiRes::time after the run to detect a cancelled or re-armed timer; no calendar time is read and nothing is slept on.

justification: No filesystem, network or environment access. The pbt-v1 property engine (VER05p, lib/) is pure and in-memory; the fuzz engine runs each target through Safe::call under a wall-clock alarm and reads the clock to check the alarm was left alone; it starts no process (a forked child of a target that returns into the engine exits through POSIX::_exit). The test suite (t/) is not shipped: it reads the committed pbt-v1 and fuzz-v1 fixtures, Go's fuzz reference-vector table and the package's own lib/ sources from the repo checkout, and bounds each test with an alarm watchdog.
